identity.title: [v0.92.1][GCP][runtime-v3] Add warm two-node Polis and GPU startup parity

review_prompts: Does the change reuse the existing GCP and AWS designs without creating unnecessary abstractions?
Can ordinary workload teardown delete a source snapshot, or leave a restored Persistent Disk accruing idle cost?
Can normal startup perform any build, package installation, Git access, or model download?
Are private networking, SSH/OS Login authority, artifact identity, and timing denominators explicit?
Do local tests avoid claiming unmeasured live GCP startup performance?
residual_risk: The paid live GCP timing and cleanup lane was not run because no exact company project and GCP spend authorization were provided; AC-8 explicitly permits this deferred disposition.
